title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
title_zh: 技能做梦：通过拉取请求流演化仓库技能

paragraphs.en: Skill Dreaming从拉取请求流中提取并持续精炼仓库技能，实现PR、仓库与技能的协同演化。 Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. To enable this co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, we propose Skill Dreaming, a framework that learns from PR streams to guide continuous repository development and maintenance. Given a repository and its PR history, Skill Dreaming builds a repository-specific skill library by extracting executable knowledge from validated PRs and continuously refines the skills as new PR information becomes available. These skills guide coding agents not only in implementing requested features but also in maintaining associated tests, documentation, compatibility, and repository conventions. By integrating PR analysis, skill management, code execution, and continuous integration, Skill Dreaming provides an end-to-end workflow for applying learned skills to repository changes and incorporating subsequent PR outcomes into future skill updates.
paragraphs.zh: Skill Dreaming 从拉取请求流中提取并持续精炼仓库技能，实现 PR、仓库与技能的协同演化。大语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂软件工程任务中越来越依赖可复用的技能，这使得技能库对仓库的开发与维护至关重要。 然而，仓库特定的技能必须随代码结构、实现惯例和维护需求的变化而演进。 拉取请求（PR）通过记录仓库如何经由实现和评审而演进，为这类知识提供了天然的来源。 与此同时，新的 PR 必须遵循仓库特定的实现模式，一致地修改相关组件，并确保现有测试继续通过，同时为新功能增加测试覆盖。 这就形成了一个相互增强的循环：PR 为更新技能提供知识，而这些技能又能改进未来的 PR、维护仓库，并支持进一步的技能演化。 为了实现 PR、仓库与技能的这种协同演化，我们提出了 Skill Dreaming，一个从 PR 流中学习以指导仓库持续开发与维护的框架。 给定一个仓库及其 PR 历史，Skill Dreaming 通过从已验证的 PR 中提取可执行的知识来构建仓库特定的技能库，并随着新 PR 信息的出现持续精炼这些技能。 这些技能不仅指导智能体实现所请求的功能，还指导其维护相关的测试、文档、兼容性以及仓库惯例。 通过整合 PR 分析、技能管理、代码执行和持续集成，Skill Dreaming 提供了一个端到端的工作流，可将学到的技能应用于仓库变更，并将后续的 PR 结果纳入未来的技能更新。
